SYSTEM 01

Heavy-Duty Pallet Racking Systems

Engineered for maximum structural integrity, high load capacity, and 100% pallet accessibility. Designed for reach trucks, counterbalanced forklifts, and VNA equipment.

1.1

Selective Pallet Racking

100% direct access to every pallet position. Most versatile configuration for dynamic SKU environments.

1.2

Double-Deep Racking

Stores pallets 2-deep per aisle entry. Increases pallet storage density by up to 30% compared to standard selective setups.

1.3

Drive-In / Drive-Through Racking

High-density LIFO/FIFO storage ideal for uniform bulk goods, cold storage, and high-volume SKU batches.
